description: Polyphonic constant voltage source, sending one hand-set value to every channel, upright on one output and inverted on the other

params.text: Sets the output voltage within the chosen range and polarity
Sets the largest voltage the outputs can reach, 1V to 10V
Chooses a unipolar output running from 0V to the set range, or a bipolar one running from minus that range to plus it
Sets how many channels both outputs carry, 1 to 16

outputs.text: Carries the set voltage on every channel
Carries the set voltage with its sign flipped, on every channel
